name: Utah Holiday "Funeral Potatoes" (Cheesy Hashbrown Casserole with Cornflake Crust)
whyItWorks: Utah's most beloved holiday side dish: peeled shredded potatoes baked with aged sharp cheddar and topped with crispy toasted cornflakes—low-fiber and seedless.
prepOrOrderInstructions: When making at home, use lactose-free sour cream, aged sharp cheddar, and Cream of Chicken soup (and leave out raw diced onions!); at a family gathering, take a Lactaid before digging in.
watchOuts: Check if the cook added diced raw/sautéed onions
High dairy fat/lactose unless made with lactose-free sour cream
